caveats: Own numpy Gaussian-HMM EM (no hmmlearn in env), quarterly-expanding refits min_obs=504 warm-started, causal FILTERED argmax states (data<=t), states relabeled by sigma per refit. Result lands on the NOTHING side for onsets: neither K=3 nor K=2 is ever in its top state at t-1 before a storm-cluster onset (n=41, |ret|>=2% with none in prior 21d), and K=3 reacts SLOWER at onset than K=2 (2.4% vs 22.0% at t; 4.9% vs 24.4% by t+5) because its crash state engages only mid-cluster (all-storm-day t-1 capture 13.6%, lift 8.76x vs 4.78x for K=2). The 3rd state's value is tail concentration (fwd RV 35.6 vol pts on 62 days), not onset timing. c1 restricted to VIX vault overlap 2011-07..2023-04; crash-state fwd-vol means are small-n (61-62 days); onset n=41 small. Vault data only; all numbers printed by scripts/opt_sweep/f02.py.
